'''''Armeria welwitschii''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the thrift family ([[Plumbaginaceae]]), endemic to central coastal [[Portugal]]. It is often cultivated as an ornamental in rock gardens.<ref>{{cite web |title=Armeria welwitschii - Thrift |url=http://www.plantoftheweek.org/week263.shtml |publisher=plantoftheweek.org |access-date=21 February 2021}}</ref>

==Description==
''Armeria welwitschii'' is a perennial evergreen subshrub up to {{convert|50|cm|abbr=on}} in height. It has numerous aerial branches, covered with dry leaves. It has lanceolate leaves that reach up to {{convert|10|cm|abbr=on}} long by {{convert|0.7|cm|abbr=on}} wide. Its pods are reddish, [[Scape (botany)|scapes]] are {{convert|7|-|30|cm|abbr=on}} long and sometimes pubescent. The [[Calyx (botany)|flower calyx]] is {{convert|7|-|10|mm|abbr=on}} and has pink to white, sometimes purple [[Petal|flower petals]]. 2n=18; n=9.<ref>{{cite web |title=Armeria welwitschii |url=http://www.floraiberica.es/floraiberica/texto/pdfs/02_055_02_Armeria.pdf |publisher=[[Flora Iberica]] |access-date=21 February 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Thrift (Armeria welwitschii) |url=http://cloud.areiasdoseixo.com/ficheiros/think_eco_plants_en.pdf |publisher=areiasdoseixo.com |access-date=21 February 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Armeria welwitschii |url=https://www.jungledragon.com/specie/15099/armeria_welwitschii.html |publisher=jungledragon.com |access-date=21 February 2021}}</ref> It flowers between February and May.<ref name="Flora-on">{{cite web |title=Armeria welwitschii Boiss |url=https://flora-on.pt/#/1Armeria+welwitschii |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=21 February 2021}}</ref>

==Distribution and habitat==
''Armeria welwitschii'' grows in sand dunes and coastal cliffs on sandy or rocky soils from [[Cabo Mondego]] south to [[Cascais]] in central coastal Portugal.<ref name="Flora-on" /> It lives in frost-free Mediterranean climates in its native habitat but can tolerate USDA [[hardiness zone]] 6.
